subject: plot map for comparing maps with different orders?

messages.author: ce16cbb0a05ab2b1
messages.subject: plot map for comparing maps with different orders?
parts:
Karl,
Thank you for all of your very timely answers to the several questions I have asked on this discussion group - I do have one more.

I have used the plot.map function to compare two different genetic maps (which have different marker orders, but the same markers on a given linkage group).  When I look at the plot it shows a linkage group size difference (as expected) but all of the lines connecting markers are 'parallel' (i.e. do not cross).  It looks like the function draws a line from the first marker on one linkage group to the first marker on the second, then the second marker on the first linkage group to the second marker on the second linkage group and so on...

This was a bit misleading for me at first as I thought that my two maps had the same marker orders.  When I was looking more closely at the map I found that the marker orders were quite different. 

Is there a way to plot the maps with lines connecting markers with the same names rather than their relative order?

Thanks!
Kevin

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot map for comparing maps with different orders?
parts:
The plot.map function assumes that the markers are in the same order in the two maps. I check that there are the same numbers of markers, but I don't check the marker names.

I'll revise this for the next version, to allow for different marker orders and even for some markers to be missing in one or the other map; it's a relatively easy fix.

karl
